LESSON: LETTER SOUND KNOWLEDGE

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
Strand: READING 2.1 Pre-reading By the end of the sub strand, the  Learners practice si
Topic 2.2: Letter sound knowledge

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Letter sound knowledge. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Letter sound knowledge
2. Practise Letter sound knowledge at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Letter sound knowledge

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Letter sound knowledge
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Letter sound knowledge. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Letter sound knowledge at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Letter sound knowledge at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Letter sound knowledge
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Letter sound knowledge. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Letter sound knowledge using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Letter sound knowledge in the examples.
2. Explain Letter sound knowledge to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Letter sound knowledge.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Letter sound knowledge using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Letter sound knowledge important for a Grade 2 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. In groups, learners look i, n, h, o, contexts. for more words without b, r, u, g letter- sound d, w, j, c, correspondence in a given y, text. Letter patterns

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Letter sound knowledge
2. Practise Letter sound knowledge at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Letter sound knowledge

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
